budgetEnforcement: Kernel CPU quota: four cores. Kernel RAM cap: 16 GiB. Capture trees use affinity on four workload CPUs and an 8 GiB aggregate summed-RSS termination guard sampled every 500 ms; this is not a strict 8 GiB kernel cap, and shared pages can be counted repeatedly.

cefPin.source: third-party CEF distribution; verified release digest and progressive MP4/MSE H.264+AAC native capture regressions

captureEncoding: H264 libx264 zerolatency; veryfast/one slice thread through 1080p, veryfast/two above 1080p, ultrafast/three at 4K; AAC 48kHz stereo 128kbps
networkBoundary: Loopback HTTP fixture and loopback RTMP receiver; no external network streaming, WebRTC or GPU validation.
